entities.summary: The Academy of Fine Arts Zagreb is a Croatian art school based in Zagreb. It is one of the three art academies affiliated with the University of Zagreb, along with the Academy of Dramatic Art (ADU) and the Academy of Music (MUZA). Academy of Fine Arts, University of Zagreb is a faculty in Zagreb, established in 1907. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
